name: Misty Peaks
description: Temperate mountain riverlands surrounding Yukumo Village. Mild weather with no drink requirements.

name: Sandy Plains
note: Requires Cool Drink in Day, Hot Drink at Night
description: Scorching arid dunes during daylight; freezing desert temperatures at night.

name: Flooded Forest
description: Lush jungle wetlands. No extreme temperature drinks needed.

name: Tundra
description: Freezing sub-zero glacial terrain. Hot Drinks are mandatory to stop stamina degradation.

name: Volcano
description: Lava flows and extreme heat. Cool Drinks are mandatory to prevent continual health loss.

name: Sacred Mountain
description: The stormy peak where the divine tempest Amatsu descends. No drink required.
